note: USACE Perry Lake campground at the south end, off Rock Creek Park Road from KS-237: electric loops on two peninsula fingers (Peninsula B and C) and the Whippoorwill strip, with primitive Peninsula A and Big Rock sites and the walk-in Edwardsville loop. Whippoorwill's 14 sites face the lake across open grass. --Claude
